coordinate_system: Right-handed world XYZ in millimetres; sketch XY normal +Z; named planes must be mapped by basis, not vendor labels

capture_policy.missing_observation: block qualification; never substitute an analytic expectation or recorded cache

comparison_tolerances.numeric_rule: absolute_difference <= max(absolute_tolerance, relative_tolerance * max(abs(left), abs(right))); relative tolerance applies only to volume
comparison_tolerances.topology_history_constraints_bindings: exact semantic correspondence; no tolerance or name masking

repeat_and_variation_protocol.change: Save the unchanged baseline twice with an application close/reopen between saves
repeat_and_variation_protocol.purpose: Identify save/session noise without assuming timestamps explain all differences

repeat_and_variation_protocol.change: Change each driving parameter independently using the recipe edits; rebuild, measure and restore before the next edit
repeat_and_variation_protocol.purpose: Distinguish a driving value from caches, unrelated doubles and coupled fields

repeat_and_variation_protocol.change: For blind bosses only, reverse +Z to -Z without changing depth magnitude
repeat_and_variation_protocol.purpose: Separate direction, support basis and additive operation

repeat_and_variation_protocol.change: Reauthor the complete baseline on YZ with basis u=+Y, v=+Z, n=+X
repeat_and_variation_protocol.purpose: Identify support-plane semantics and transformed center of mass

repeat_and_variation_protocol.change: Change display units to inches while retaining identical physical geometry; record expressions and bindings
repeat_and_variation_protocol.purpose: Separate display units from storage units and evaluated quantities

repeat_and_variation_protocol.change: Reauthor the blind cut as through-all in a separately labelled variant
repeat_and_variation_protocol.purpose: Distinguish termination grammar; through-all is outside the initial blind-cut profile

split_policy.unit: whole recipe family and every native authoring lineage, including repeat saves, edits and descendants
split_policy.rule: Do not fit rules on holdout captures; changing the split requires a new specification digest and a new independent family
split_policy.existing_inputs: Provisional lineage reservations only; imported authorship and independence remain unverified; byte duplicates cannot cross splits

recipes.name: Dimensioned rectangular sketch
constraints: Four endpoint coincidences close the loop
Two horizontal and two vertical edge constraints
Driving width on lower horizontal edge
Driving height on left vertical edge

recipes.name: Dimensioned circular sketch
constraints: Driving diameter; retain the diameter-to-radius binding

recipes.name: Blind rectangular cut with parent body

cut_sketch.support: top planar face of parent boss at z=depth_mm
constraints: Closed rectangular loop with horizontal/vertical edges
Center follows parent width/2 and height/2 through expressions
Driving cut width and cut height
cut_sketch.dependency: support face and center expressions refer to the parent; do not replace by a coincident independent plane

recipes.name: Full annular revolution about explicit axis
constraints: Four coincident endpoint pairs close the rectangle
Two horizontal and two vertical edges
Driving inner radius, outer radius and height
Axis explicitly bound to world Z; do not infer from labels

missing_dependencies.required: Both independently authored native captures for every recipe, with repeat saves and controlled edits

missing_dependencies.unblocks: Qualification of historical or new observations
missing_dependencies.required: Receipts bind exact native SHA-256, recipe digest, application build and healthy controls

missing_dependencies.unblocks: Reproduction of historical controlled SOLIDWORKS observations
missing_dependencies.required: Original .rescratch corpora and their capture provenance; old report paths alone are insufficient
Explicit isolated authoring/acceptance worker access in A08; never a production conversion dependency
